x-apievangelist-provenance.source: https://api.os.uk/ and every rel=api-grouping document reachable from it
x-apievangelist-provenance.note: Ordnance Survey serves a machine-readable link index (title/description/links[] with rel=self|landing-page|api-grouping|service-endpoint|documentation) at the api.os.uk root and at every API grouping path. This is the provider's own API catalogue. It is NOT served at /.well-known/api-catalog: api.os.uk answers 200 with this same landing document for any unknown path, so /.well-known/* probes are catch-all responses rather than real discovery documents.

links.title: OS Names API Find Operation
links.description: A free string text search of OS Names, intended to be an ambiguous/fuzzy search. Find can locate a feature using just its name.

links.title: OS Names API Nearest Operation
links.description: The nearest resource returns the closest address to a given point. This is done by using a pair of BNG coordinates (to two decimal places or less) as the input. The property will only be considered to be included by the search if the Address Seed is in range of the search, regardless of the property's physical boundaries.

links.title: Linked Identifier Lookup Operation
links.description: Replace {id} with an identifier to Look up that identifier and find its associated identifiers, returns a list.

links.title: Linked Identifier Feature Type Lookup Operation
links.description: Looks up linked identifiers when the input feature type is known. Replace {featureType} and {id} with the feature type and identifier.

links.title: Linked Identifier, Identifier Type Lookup Operation
links.description: Looks up linked identifiers when the input identifier type is known. Replace {identifierType} and {id} with the identifier type and identifier.

links.title: Linked Identifier Current Product Version Info Lookup Operation
links.description: This service is available as a GET resource method allowing you to discover the current product version information. Replace {correlationMethod} with a correlation method from the correlation method table found in the Technical Specification.

document.title: OS Places API
document.description: Identify addresses accurately with OS Places API.

links.title: OS Search APIs
links.description: The available Search APIs offered by Ordnance Survey. These are provided as RESTful or Remote Procedure Call services.

links.title: OS Places API Find Operation
links.description: A free text search designed for quick use.

links.title: OS Places API postcode Operation
links.description: A search based on a property's postcode. The minimum for the resource is the area and district e.g. SO16, and will accept a full postcode consisting of the area, district, sector and unit e.g. SO16 0AS .

links.title: OS Places API UPRN Operation
links.description: A search that takes a UPRN as the search parameter.

links.title: OS Places API nearest Operation
links.description: Takes a pair of coordinates (X and Y) as an input to determine the closest address.

links.title: OS Places API bbox Operation
links.description: Takes two points and creates a bounding box. All addresses within this bounding box are then returned.

links.title: OS Places API radius Operation
links.description: Takes a pair of coordinates as the centre for a circle and returns all addresses that are intersected by it.

links.title: OS Places API polygon Operation
links.description: A POST Request that takes a geoJSON polygon or multi-polygon object and returns all addresses that are in the object.
